text: Gardening is a rewarding hobby that requires patience and dedication. One of the first steps is to prune your plants, carefully cutting away dead or overgrown branches to promote new growth and maintain their shape. Pruning also helps to direct the plant's energy towards more productive areas, leading to healthier and more vibrant blooms. Pruning should be done in the early morning or late evening to reduce evaporation and ensure the water reaches the roots effectively. Regular watering is necessary to keep your plants moist and prevent them from drying out. By following these steps, you can ensure your plants thrive and flourish in your garden.
